name: Zabvenie
source:
Watanabe Satou is an ordinary schoolboy from the small provincial town of Terawata.
One day he discovered that his classmate Yusaki Rin was missing. Strangely enough, no one in the class remembered her. Yusaki was always so cheerful and upbeat, and Satou couldn't believe that everyone had just forgotten about her.
As he investigated, Satou began to notice strange things. His own childhood memories seemed to disappear, and he couldn't remember how he spent his time as a child.
Satou realized that it was up to him to penetrate the mystery of erased memories to find answers and save his friend before she finally disappeared into the shadows of the past.
translation:
Watanabe Satou是来自偏远小镇Terawata的一名普通男学生。
一天，他发现同班同学Yusaki Rin失踪了。奇怪的是，班上竟没有人记得她。Yusaki向来开朗活泼，Satou不敢相信，所有人居然都把她忘了。
调查过程中，Satou开始察觉异样。他自己的童年记忆似乎也在消失，想不起小时候究竟是怎么过的。
Satou意识到，自己必须揭开记忆被抹去的谜团，找到答案，并在朋友彻底消失于往昔阴影之前，将她救回。
